reviews.text: Federico and Elena are two wonderful people! From day one, we had a great time with them and couldn't have been happier. We left for a trip overseas, and I admit I was nervous and scared about leaving our cats home alone for the first time. But with Elena and Federico, we had such a peaceful time. They constantly updated us with photos and videos and were meticulous and attentive to everything, even things we hadn't thought of and that weren't their job. Thank you so much because you are incredible, and Yoru and Kurumi couldn't have spent a happier day. Even though we weren't home, they were cared for with love, affection, and care. Thank you so much!!! And see you soon! 😍❤️

Federico is a very serious, helpful, and empathetic person. He's able to ask the right questions to understand what you need, organize accordingly, and keep you updated every step of the way. Even with cats that are a bit more complicated and a bit battered, like ours. He's incredibly attentive and patient, even when it takes a while to get to know them! Highly recommended!

This is the second time we have used Federico's services. He has been very attentive to our dog's needs. He is reliable and a guarantee for Zodiac, taking meticulous care of his play, health and food, and also advising us on various aspects.

We definitely made the best choice with Pet Sitter Roma. The initial contact and arrangements were very professional, and we had a great feeling about them from the start. Our little Elli isn't often away from us, but she took to Elena immediately. Elena is a very warm, friendly, and loving person. While we were away, she sent us photos and kept us updated on how things were going. We were able to enjoy our concert evening in peace, knowing Elli was in the best possible hands. Thank you so much for the wonderful care. We will definitely use your service again when we're back in Rome ❤️

If you're reading this, you're looking for proven care for your friend - you've come to the right place! Elena spent time with our two adopted Yorkies. It may seem that these are trouble-free dogs, but we still wanted them to be well cared for because they had already experienced a lot of bad things in their lives. We chose Elena because of the reviews and we can honestly recommend her! As soon as I saw her, I knew it would be fine! our dogs had a great time with her and we were calm and visited Rome. we were informed about their condition and well-being along with photos. In addition, Elena was flexible with her hours, which gave us additional peace of mind - we recommend her with a clear conscience! One more time Elena we are soooooo greatfull- dziękujemy!

I turned to them for my graduation day in Rome, so I could leave Dobby, my dad's dog, in good hands during the ceremony and the graduation ceremony.
I couldn't have made a better choice! Their kindness and helpfulness were unparalleled. Impeccable service and fantastic communication before and during the ceremony. Dobby had a great time, and so was my dad!
Great professionalism. A wonderful experience for everyone.
Thank you so much!
Desy, Cesare, and Dobby

federico was amazing with my pup, yuna! i travel a lot with my shiba inu and she’s a little anxious and shy but he was super gentle with her and let her take her time! federico was accommodating to my switching schedules since i was on vacation to rome from nyc and communication was super fast and effortless as someone who doesn’t speak italian and only english! :) he was happy to do a meet and greet with us at our hotel in rome and he sent cute photos of yuna when he was with her! thank you and hope to see you again soon when we go back to rome! i would highly recommend him 🐾

I asked Federico for help with giving my chubby, somewhat wary four-year-old Cleo a little exercise every week. She unexpectedly took to him immediately, having sensed her love for furry friends. I noticed his affectionate professionalism in caring for her from the first meeting.
I hope he can dedicate even more time to Cleo, given the many requests she faces. Thank you!

Federico was fantastic with our two dogs the weekend we were away: we dropped them off at their grandparents' house, and he came twice a day to walk them. Punctual, empathetic, and kind: we, our dogs, and the grandparents loved him! When we returned, we even found a completely unexpected and unnecessary gift for the dogs. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!
Elena was incredibly kind and sweet. A great service for visiting museums with your pups in tow!
Thank you so much! 🙏🏼 …

Federico and Elena... what can I say about them, simply wonderful! We're from the Marche region, and last weekend for our daughter's birthday, we took a short trip to Rome. I contacted them a few days before leaving for support during the guided tours, where our dog (a 3.5-month-old Husky) couldn't come. They were a perfect choice! We enjoyed our guided tours, and she, along with Federico and Elena, took some lovely walks around the area and even took a few naps 🤣🤣.
Highly recommended! Thank you so much, guys!

We entrusted Federico with our three dogs for an entire afternoon. He was excellent, regularly updating us with videos and photos, and we felt completely at ease knowing they were in good hands. Thank you, Federico!
Elena and Federico are two wonderful people. My two furry children adore them. Highly recommended.

Federico is a true professional. He took excellent care of our cat. He was very sweet and played with her a lot. We received many photos and videos and detailed updates on her health. Thank you so much!
Thank you Federico and Elena!!! You are fantastic!!! So loving, available to play, and attentive to our pets' needs. I absolutely recommend them!!!

We left our little Chihuahua with Federico, who is very timid and fearful, but everything went very well with him. We connected immediately because he was very kind and gentle with my dog, and thanks to him, my husband and I were able to visit St. Peter's Basilica.

I highly recommend Federico because he is very professional and has extensive experience with animals.

Federico cared for my cat Greta with the utmost care and love during my vacation.
Greta needs to be encouraged to eat wet food, and Federico quickly learned how to persuade her. Every day, from the videos he sent me, I saw that Greta was thrilled with Federico's arrival; he always played with her and cuddled her, making sure she didn't miss a thing.
My vacation was absolutely worry-free for the cat, and upon my return, I found her healthy and happy.
I recommend entrusting your animal friends to Federico.

It was the first time I entrusted my kittens to strangers, but like cats, I have a sixth sense for people. I would like to thank Elena for her kindness and reliability, and for the cuddles she gave my furry friends. See you soon, Roby.
The service is perfect, Federico is a pet sitter attentive to the needs of animals and was able to patiently handle my cat with her prickly nature.
Elena is a truly special person and also her partner Federico, they are a great team and very professional and loving, I would recommend them to anyone who needs a cat/dog sitter!

Professional, reliable...perfect! Maximum peace of mind when leaving your little friend at home, with personalized care that ranges from feeding, to cleaning and grooming, to playtime.
My cat immediately loved her new friend and spent her time playing with him. Highly recommended.
The guys are thorough and reliable. I personally met Elena, who took care of three cats during our work days with a house sitting service. Highly recommended! :D
Elena is very nice and kind. She sent me lots of photos of her walks with Megi (my dog).
Elena and Federico are reliable, precise, very helpful and they do everything they can to make the pets they look after feel good, absolutely irreplaceable.
Fantastic experience, very kind and very attentive to always updating us on the progress of the day, Snoopy had a great time, we will definitely be back!!
Highly recommended. Federico is kind and knowledgeable. He knows how to care for your cat and will send you plenty of videos during his visits. He's also very thorough; you're in good hands with him.
Thanks to Federico, you can enjoy a few days off with complete peace of mind, leaving your pet in good hands. Many thanks!!

We recently chose Pet Sitter Roma and couldn't be happier—and neither could Diego (our cat)! We don't like leaving Diego home alone, especially since he needs to take his medication every 12 hours. Federico took care of everything flawlessly. He kept us updated with photos and videos, and we felt completely at ease the entire time. We moved to Rome three months ago and feel truly fortunate to have found the best cat sitter in the city. Highly recommended!
Elena was kind and super attentive to the little furry friend. She sent me photos and videos every day. Thank you.

I can’t thank Federico enough for taking such great care of my cat while I was away. She had never been alone for this long before, and I was quite worried, but Federico made everything so much easier. He kept me updated with photos and videos, which reassured me and made me feel much more at ease. It’s clear that he truly loves animals and puts a lot of effort into making them feel comfortable. My cat really enjoyed his company!

If you’re looking for a caring, responsible, and trustworthy pet sitter, I highly recommend Federico.

It suddenly hit me, at ten o'clock at night, with a dire need for a cat sitter for the next day. After spending over an hour searching through ridiculously bureaucratic websites, Federico and Elena's website popped up, with their cell phone number prominently displayed! A five-minute chat, and I knew I'd be in good hands. Elena arrived on time, and the service was perfect. Now I know I can rely on them with peace of mind in the future.

Very helpful, friendly, loves animals.. He immediately inspired me with confidence, for as long as he held my dog, he sent me a video to reassure me that she was fine. When I picked up my dog ​​she was relaxed and happy.  incredible man!  Thank you Federico!  On my next visit I will prefer him.  I recommend him for sure...

I left my poodle during our visit to the Vatican Museums. We were very satisfied. Federico was very empathetic and made a great impression on us right away. During the visit, he sent us some photos he took during the walk. Everything went smoothly. I highly recommend him. Thanks Federico, see you next time!

A kind, competent, and animal-loving person. Highly recommended for anyone with places to visit in the capital and needing to leave their dog in his care for a few hours. Federico is truly competent; he made my little Hera feel at ease …

Federico met us today at the entrance of the Vatican museums and took excellent care of our yorkshire terrier puppy while we were having the visist. Federico succeeded to very quickly have our Fuzzy adapting to him and he quickly went with …

I met Federico while looking for someone to care for my cats while I was away because the person who had been doing it for many years could no longer come for health reasons. I was also very worried because one of my cats has been suffering …

Excellent experience. Federico is very knowledgeable and does his job with great professionalism, patience, and expertise. I highly recommend entrusting your furry friends to Pet Sitter Roma; you'll be very satisfied.

For the first time this summer, I turned to Federico and Elena for summer care for our cat Luna. It was a great experience! Elena took great care of Luna, letting her play and sending us constant updates. We will definitely turn to them again as soon as we need a hand. Silvia
Federico was very attentive to our cat's needs, knowledgeable and affectionate. When we returned from a long trip, we found her very well. Thank you very much, highly recommended.
